judgment: It is good to hold firm, as a mare does.
first lost, then a master is found.
It is good to find friends in the south-west;
in the north-east, friends are lost.
image: The earth lies open to all: Earth.
So the noble one carries things
lines: A brightness held inside: can hold firm.
nothing completed, yet brought to an end.
Their blood is black and yellow.
special: It is good to hold firm, long.

notes.name_en: 坤 doubled earth trigram; the thing named, rejecting 'The Receptive'.
notes.judgment: 牝馬之貞: a mare's holding firm (following, enduring). 先迷後得主 'first lost, then finds a master'.
notes.L3: 含章 'a pattern/brightness held within'; 無成有終 kept as paradox, not explained.
notes.L6: 玄黃 black (heaven-dark) and yellow (earth): blood of both colours, kept literal.
